item_random_effect_decision.formula: response_external ~ condition * source_truth + (1 + source_truth | participant_id) + (1 | item_id)
item_random_effect_decision.rationale: item source is counterbalanced across participants, so item variability is separable from source_truth; the by-item random intercept controls item heterogeneity.
item_random_effect_decision.validation_note: synthetic validation: with item variance present the full model converges non-singularly; on generators with zero item variance the item term is singular by construction.
